beliefs: Repeated calls at the same x give very different values, so f is stochastic with large noise [E3, E4, E8, E12, E15, E16]
The noise spread is roughly ±1.5 units around the mean, with values spanning about -2.7 to +4.1 [E8, E12, E16]
The conditional mean is near 0 for x just below 0 and jumps to ~2 for x just above 0 [E21, E22, E23, E24]
The step from ~0 to ~2 occurs between x=0 and x=0.002, essentially at x=0 from the positive side [E24]
Mean at x=0.5 is about +2.0 (E16 avg ~2.0, E17 avg ~1.7, E18 avg ~3.0) [E16, E17, E18]
Mean at x=1 is about +2.2 (E14 avg ~2.2, E17 avg ~2.3) [E14, E17]
Mean at x=2 is about +2.1 (E13 avg ~2.1, E14 avg ~1.9, E17 avg ~2.0) [E13, E14, E17]
Mean at x=2.5 is about +2.6 and at x=3 about +1.6, at x=3.5 about +1.9 (E17) [E17]
Mean stays near +2 through x≈4-5, then decays: ~1.8 at x=4, ~0.5 at x=5, ~1.8 at x=6, ~1.6 at x=7, ~2.2 at x=8, ~0.1 at x=10, ~0.6 at x=16 (E25) [E25]
Mean at x=-0.5 is about +0.04 and at x=-1 about +0.13 (E15) [E15]
Mean at x=-6 is about -1.6, at x=-5 about -1.3, at x=-4 about -1.0, at x=-3 about -0.2, at x=-2 about -0.1 (E5) [E5]
Mean at x=8 is about +0.8 and at x=-8 about -1.2 (E10) [E10]
Mean at x=64 is about +0.1 and at x=100 about +0.7 (E11), at x=-64 about -1.3 and at x=-100 about -0.5 (E11) [E11]
The mean is roughly flat/plateauing far out on each side (near -1 to -1.5 on the far left, near +1 on the far right) [E6, E7, E9, E11]
The mean curve is ~0 for x<0, jumps to ~2 just above x=0, stays ~2 through x≈4-5, then decays toward ~1 far right [E12-E25]
predict() should return the conditional mean (smooth trend), not any noisy wiggle [E3, E4]
